_comment: Hand-curated adapter assignment for every registered base Iron's spell. Input to tools/generate_iron_glyph_catalog.py. Families: caster = resolves at the caster, Self form only; aimed = the spell's own targeting helpers (preCastTargetHelper, RaycastBuilder, raycastForEntity/Block, getTargetBlock) receive the Ars target; projectile = native projectiles are delivered from just before the Ars target; movement = moves the caster to the Ars target position; summon = native summons are placed at the Ars target position. Reasons cite the decompiled 1.20.1-3.16.3 source.

irons_spellbooks:acid_orb.reason: Launches an AcidOrb from the caster's eye along its look.

irons_spellbooks:acupuncture.reason: preCastTargetHelper target; needles spawn around the target.

irons_spellbooks:arcane_shackle.reason: Launches an ArcaneShackleProjectile along the caster's look.

irons_spellbooks:arrow_volley.reason: Target from preCastTargetHelper or a RaycastBuilder aim point; the volley spawns above it.

irons_spellbooks:ascension.reason: Lightning and knock-up around the caster, which is launched upward.

irons_spellbooks:ball_lightning.reason: Launches a BallLightning along the caster's look.

irons_spellbooks:black_hole.reason: RaycastBuilder aim point is the black hole's centre.

irons_spellbooks:blaze_storm.reason: Channel that fires blaze fireballs along the caster's current look every 5 ticks.

irons_spellbooks:blizzard.reason: Target or RaycastBuilder aim point is the blizzard's spawn.

irons_spellbooks:blood_needles.reason: Needles spawn around the caster and fly at the RaycastBuilder aim point.

irons_spellbooks:blood_slash.reason: Launches a BloodSlashProjectile along the caster's look.

irons_spellbooks:blood_step.reason: Teleports the caster to its aim: behind an entity hit, else findTeleportLocation.

irons_spellbooks:burning_dash.reason: Dashes the caster along its own look direction.

irons_spellbooks:chain_creeper.reason: Target or RaycastBuilder aim point spawns the creeper chain.

irons_spellbooks:cleanse.reason: Cleanses entities around the caster's own position.

irons_spellbooks:cloud_of_regeneration.reason: Heals around the caster each pulse. Disabled by default in Iron's (deprecated).

irons_spellbooks:cone_of_cold.reason: Channelled cone attached to the caster's look.

irons_spellbooks:counterspell.reason: RaycastBuilder from the eye picks the anti-magic target.

irons_spellbooks:divine_smite.reason: raycastForBlock from the eye picks the smite location.

irons_spellbooks:dragon_breath.reason: Channelled cone attached to the caster's look.

irons_spellbooks:earthquake.reason: Target or RaycastBuilder aim point is the earthquake's centre.

irons_spellbooks:eldritch_blast.reason: RaycastBuilder ray from the eye; damages the entity it hits. Recast spell.

irons_spellbooks:electrocute.reason: Channelled cone attached to the caster's look.

irons_spellbooks:fang_strike.reason: A line of fangs along the caster's horizontal forward.

irons_spellbooks:fang_swirl.reason: Target or RaycastBuilder aim point is the swirl's destination.

irons_spellbooks:fang_ward.reason: A ring of fangs around the caster.

irons_spellbooks:fire_arrow.reason: Launches a FireArrowProjectile along the caster's look.

irons_spellbooks:fire_breath.reason: Channelled cone attached to the caster's look.

irons_spellbooks:fireball.reason: Launches a MagicFireball along the caster's look.

irons_spellbooks:firebolt.reason: Launches a FireboltProjectile along the caster's look.

irons_spellbooks:firecracker.reason: RaycastBuilder aim point places the firework.

irons_spellbooks:firefly_swarm.reason: preCastTargetHelper target is chased by the swarm.

irons_spellbooks:flaming_barrage.reason: Homing small fireballs launched along the caster's forward. Recast spell.

irons_spellbooks:flaming_strike.reason: A slash in front of the caster.

irons_spellbooks:fortify.reason: Buffs allies within 8 blocks of the caster.

irons_spellbooks:frost_step.reason: Teleports the caster to its aim (TeleportData or findTeleportLocation).

irons_spellbooks:gravity_fissure.reason: A moving black hole launched along the caster's forward.

irons_spellbooks:guiding_bolt.reason: Launches a GuidingBoltProjectile along the caster's look.

irons_spellbooks:gust.reason: A gust in front of the caster with kickback on the caster.

irons_spellbooks:haste.reason: preCastTargetHelper ally target, else the caster.

irons_spellbooks:healing_circle.reason: Target or RaycastBuilder aim point is the circle's centre.

irons_spellbooks:ice_block.reason: Target or RaycastBuilder aim point is where the ice block falls.

irons_spellbooks:ice_spikes.reason: preCastTargetHelper target is the spike line's end.

irons_spellbooks:icicle.reason: Launches an IcicleProjectile along the caster's look.

irons_spellbooks:lightning_lance.reason: Launches a LightningLanceProjectile along the caster's look.

irons_spellbooks:lob_creeper.reason: Lobs a CreeperHeadProjectile along the caster's forward.

irons_spellbooks:magic_arrow.reason: Launches a MagicArrowProjectile along the caster's look.

irons_spellbooks:magic_missile.reason: Launches a MagicMissileProjectile along the caster's look.

irons_spellbooks:magma_bomb.reason: Launches a FireBomb along the caster's look.

irons_spellbooks:pocket_dimension.reason: Moves the caster into its pocket dimension.

irons_spellbooks:poison_arrow.reason: Launches a PoisonArrow along the caster's look.

irons_spellbooks:poison_breath.reason: Channelled cone attached to the caster's look.

irons_spellbooks:poison_splash.reason: Target or RaycastBuilder aim point is splashed.

irons_spellbooks:portal.reason: getTargetBlock picks a portal frame or the portal's placement. Recast spell.

irons_spellbooks:raise_dead.reason: Summons undead around the caster's eye. Recast spell.

irons_spellbooks:raise_hell.reason: raycastForBlock from the eye picks the eruption's location. Recast spell.

irons_spellbooks:ray_of_frost.reason: RaycastBuilder ray from the eye; freezes what it hits.

irons_spellbooks:ray_of_siphoning.reason: Channel; each pulse's RaycastBuilder ray from the eye siphons what it hits.

irons_spellbooks:recall.reason: Moves the caster to its respawn point.

irons_spellbooks:sacrifice.reason: raycastForEntity picks one of the caster's own summons, which explodes.

irons_spellbooks:scapegoat.reason: raycastForBlock aim point is where the scapegoat goes.

irons_spellbooks:scorch.reason: RaycastBuilder aim point is the scorched area.

irons_spellbooks:sculk_tentacles.reason: Target or RaycastBuilder aim point is the tentacles' centre.

irons_spellbooks:shadow_slash.reason: A slash cone along the caster's forward.

irons_spellbooks:shield.reason: RaycastBuilder aim point (range 3) places the shield.

irons_spellbooks:slow.reason: preCastTargetHelper target (not the caster, not an ally) is slowed.

irons_spellbooks:snowball.reason: Launches a snowball orb along the caster's look.

irons_spellbooks:sonic_boom.reason: A ray along the caster's forward, not through Iron's raycast helpers.

irons_spellbooks:spectral_hammer.reason: getTargetBlock aim point is where the hammer strikes.

irons_spellbooks:starfall.reason: Channel centred on the RaycastBuilder aim point.

irons_spellbooks:stomp.reason: A stomp in front of the caster.

irons_spellbooks:summon_horse.reason: Summons a mount at the caster. Recast spell.

irons_spellbooks:summon_polar_bear.reason: Summons a polar bear at the caster. Recast spell.

irons_spellbooks:summon_swords.reason: Summons weapons that orbit the caster. Recast spell.

irons_spellbooks:summon_vex.reason: Summons vexes near the caster. Recast spell.

irons_spellbooks:sunbeam.reason: Target or RaycastBuilder aim point is where the beam lands.

irons_spellbooks:teleport.reason: Teleports the caster to its aim (TeleportData or findTeleportLocation).

irons_spellbooks:throw.reason: Throws an item along the caster's look.

irons_spellbooks:thunderstorm.reason: Applies THUNDERSTORM to the caster; strikes around it.

irons_spellbooks:touch_dig.reason: Breaks the block the caster's aim hits.

irons_spellbooks:volt_strike.reason: Dashes the caster along its look.

irons_spellbooks:wall_of_fire.reason: Recast anchors are placed at the caster's aim point.

irons_spellbooks:wisp.reason: preCastTargetHelper target is chased by the wisp.

irons_spellbooks:wither_skull.reason: Launches a WitherSkullProjectile along the caster's forward.
